headline: FUEL
THE
WORK
lead: Tracking food is this easy: a whole day logged, protein goal hit.

headline: SNAP IT.
lead: One photo of the plate comes back itemized, and nothing is logged until you say so.
bullets: Eight foods, each on its own line with its own calories.
A confidence read on every row: High or Medium.
Not right? Type the fix: "it was 6 tacos."

headline: SAY IT.
lead: No photo, no problem. Describe the meal in your own words instead.
bullets: "grilled chicken, rice and broccoli" is enough to start.
Works from your words alone. A photo is optional.
Then the same review: check every line, then log it.

headline: FIND IT.
lead: When you already know what it was, the whole database is one field away.
bullets: Search foods and saved meals, brands and calories included.
Barcode, snap and upload, all on the same sheet.
Your foods, recents and frequents, one tap each.

headline: START
TONIGHT'S
LOG.
lead: Tonight's dinner is one photo and a tap away.

headline: TRAIN. EAT.
REFLECT.
REPEAT.
lead: Body, mind, and routine working together, every day.

headline: TRAIN.
lead: The work is written before you walk in: sets, reps, and the rest between them.
bullets: Coach-built programs in phases, a named day for every session.
Generate a session from your focus, level and equipment.
Log set by set, last time's weight in view, new PRs flagged.

headline: EAT.
lead: Eat whatever you want. Track it however you want.
bullets: Snap the plate and it comes back itemized, line by line.
No photo? Describe the meal in your own words instead.
Barcode, search, saved foods and recents, one tap each.

headline: REFLECT.
lead: A few minutes a day on the part of this that actually decides it.
bullets: One short session a day: check in, name a win, lock it in.
Finish it, bank the XP, and the next chapter opens.
Then the Training Grounds: State Shift, Vision, Discipline.

headline: REPEAT.
lead: Perfect weeks are not the point. Coming back the next day is.
bullets: Any activity keeps the day streak alive: a workout, a meal, a check-in.
A workout streak counts rest days, as long as the week stays on track.
Three in a row makes a streak, and a freeze covers the day you miss.

headline: START THE
PRACTICE.
lead: One loop a day, and it takes far less work than you think.

headline: BECOME
WHAT'S
NEXT.
lead: The strongest version of you is built, not found.

headline: PROGRAMS.
lead: Pick a coach-built program and the week arrives already written.
bullets: Programs run in phases, with a named day for each session.
Your week fills in: training days, rest days, today's work.
Generate a session from your focus, level and equipment.

headline: SNAP IT.
lead: The plate comes back itemized, and nothing logs until you add it.
bullets: One plate, eight items, 977 calories, line by line.
Every line is marked High or Medium confidence.
Wrong count? Say it in words: "it was 6 tacos."

headline: RECAP.
lead: Each week comes back as one card, written from what you did.
bullets: Mind, Fuel and Training on one strip, a dot per day.
The week gets a headline: 8 personal records, a new high.
Mind 5 sessions, food 7 of 7, training 6 against 4.
